# [TASK] Instrument all services: Prometheus metrics + JSON structured logging

## Task
Add Prometheus metrics + JSON structured logging to every backend service (all 8 Gradle modules: api-gateway, discovery, config, movie, user, actor, ai, media). No infrastructure required — verifiable with curl.

## Parent Story
Parent: #87

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `curl :PORT/actuator/prometheus` serves metrics on every running service, each sample tagged `application=<service>` — verified live on the 6 runnable services (gateway, movie, user, actor, discovery, config)
- [x] Logs are single-line JSON on stdout — verified live; the Spring startup banner (the one non-JSON line, printed before logback initializes) is disabled
- [x] Readiness/liveness probes enabled (`management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled=true`) on all 8 services
- [x] Each testable module has a `PrometheusEndpointTest` asserting `/actuator/prometheus` returns metrics
- [x] All existing tests green — 376 tests, 0 failures across all 7 modules on a forced `--rerun-tasks` run

## Estimate
**Hours:** 7

## Notes
Metrics/logging are wired once in the root Gradle build (`plugins.withId('org.springframework.boot')` + a shared `backend/observability/logback-spring.xml`), so a service added later can't silently ship uninstrumented.

Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §12.1–12.2
